description: This Java class implements a background service for managing asynchronous download requests within the F-Droid app. It handles queuing, progress updates, cancellation, and completion of downloads, utilizing Android's JobIntentService. It interacts with other components like Downloader, InstallManagerService, and various data classes to facilitate app package downloads and updates.

classes.name: DownloaderService
classes.description: An Android service that manages asynchronous download requests, handling queuing, progress updates, cancellations, and completion notifications within the F-Droid app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, setting up the InstallManagerService and LocalBroadcastManager.

methods.name: onHandleWork
methods.description: Processes incoming intents to handle download requests based on action type.

methods.name: onStopCurrentWork
methods.description: Handles service stop requests, cancels active downloads if any.

methods.name: handleIntent
methods.description: Performs the actual download process, including setting up the downloader, handling progress, success, and error states.

methods.name: sendBroadcast
methods.description: Sends local broadcast intents to notify other components about download status updates.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Enqueues a download request with specified repository ID and URLs.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Enqueues a download request with app and APK data.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing or queued download based on the canonical URL.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if a download for a given URL is currently active.

methods.name: getIntentFilter
methods.description: Prepares an intent filter for listening to download-related actions for a specific URL.
